This invocation confirmed all of phase-6's actual work was already complete from the prior invocation (workflow + ai-governance domains, knowledge_engine registration, phase close-out, both SUCCESS_CRITERIA verified live) — `PROGRESS.md` just hadn't been updated to reflect it. I've now corrected `PROGRESS.md`.

The one remaining step, opening the PR, is currently blocked by a real GitHub-side outage: both `gh pr create` (GraphQL) and a direct REST `POST /pulls` call returned HTTP 500, while basic API access (`gh api repos/...`) works fine — so this isn't an auth or payload problem, GitHub's PR-creation endpoint itself is erroring. Per the stop-after-2-failures rule, I'm not retrying a third time this invocation; the next invocation just needs to retry PR creation once GitHub recovers, everything else is done.
